proposed_comments.title: Do not intercept Alt-modified snap chords in no-cycle mode
proposed_comments.body:
### Do not intercept Alt-modified snap chords in no-cycle mode

**Severity:** `high`

When cycling is disabled, the new index-mode Up/Down path should not intercept Win+Ctrl+Alt+Up/Down. The hook already treats that chord specially, but the hotkey gate does not know whether Alt is down, so the new fallback can swallow the chord and run FancyZones maximize/minimize behavior instead of the intended Alt-modified handling. Please pass the Alt state into the gate and only enable the new index-mode Up/Down path when Alt is not pressed.

confidence.rationale: The current hook accepts Alt-modified Up/Down chords while the new gate has only the virtual key, so this is a direct behavior regression in the reviewed head.

proposed_comments.title: Use native minimize semantics for the Win+Down fallback
proposed_comments.body:
### Use native minimize semantics for the Win+Down fallback

**Severity:** `high`

The Win+Down fallback currently sets `WINDOWPLACEMENT.showCmd` to `SW_SHOWMINIMIZED`. That shows the window minimized while keeping activation semantics different from a user-initiated minimize, so focus can remain with the minimized app instead of moving normally. Use `SW_MINIMIZE` for the Down fallback while keeping `SW_SHOWMAXIMIZED` for Up.

confidence.rationale: The reviewed code directly assigns SW_SHOWMINIMIZED on the Down fallback; Win+Down should follow the native minimize activation path.

proposed_comments.title: Separate snap failure from no directional target
proposed_comments.body:
### Separate snap failure from no directional target

**Severity:** `high`

Win+Up/Down should maximize or minimize only when there is genuinely no directional zone target. A real `WorkArea::Snap` failure should be returned as failure instead of being reinterpreted as a boundary, and any `WINDOWPLACEMENT` read must initialize `length` and handle failure before changing state. Otherwise an internal snap failure or invalid placement query can incorrectly turn into maximize/minimize behavior.

confidence.rationale: The reviewed path stores only a boolean success value and then falls back to window-state changes, which conflates failed snapping with hitting the edge.

proposed_comments.title: Align Settings serialization with the native default
proposed_comments.body:
### Align Settings serialization with the native default

**Severity:** `medium`

The new Settings property is constructed without the native default value, while the runtime default keeps zone cycling enabled. Please add a named Settings default that matches the native default and use it when creating the `FancyzonesCycleThroughAllZones` property, so a missing or newly created settings file does not serialize an unintended value.

confidence.rationale: The reviewed property uses a bare BoolProperty constructor while the native setting has an explicit enabled-by-default value.

proposed_comments.title: Add deterministic boundary and persistence regression coverage
proposed_comments.body:
### Add deterministic boundary and persistence regression coverage

**Severity:** `medium`

Please cover cycling-disabled navigation in both index and position modes, single- and multi-monitor transitions, global-edge stops, unsnapped windows, and maximize/restore/minimize state changes. Also add Settings coverage proving the toggle persists and native serialization coverage for `cycle-through-zones=false` so the new option does not regress across UI, settings files, and runtime behavior.

confidence.rationale: The current PR has only limited settings parsing coverage and does not exercise the key no-cycle keyboard boundary scenarios.

prs.testInstructions: Launch a PowerToys Debug build, disable zone cycling in FancyZones settings, and verify adjacent-monitor movement, global-edge stopping, Alt-modified snap chords, and maximize/restore/minimize sequencing.

tests.detail: The broader VSTest run later exited with access violation during mock-window teardown; the deterministic changed-behavior subset passed cleanly.

verification.localBuildNote: The machine lacks Spectre libraries. The documented conditional POWERTOYS_DISABLE_SPECTRE property overrides were applied only for local validation, restored afterward, and never committed or pushed.

test_instructions: Open Settings → FancyZones → Window behavior, toggle the new zone-cycling option off, restart PowerToys, and confirm the value persists.
With Override Windows Snap enabled, move a window through zones with Win+Left/Right and Win+Up/Down. Confirm it can cross to an adjacent monitor but stops without wrapping at the global edge.
From an unsnapped or intermediate-zone window, press Win+Up/Down and confirm it navigates to the next zone before maximizing or minimizing.
Maximize a zoned window, then press Win+Down repeatedly. Confirm the first press restores, subsequent presses navigate downward, and only the true bottom boundary minimizes.
